name: Fieldnotes
description: A qualitative research workspace connecting original fictional interviews, manual highlights, themes and evidence-backed insight notes.
tagline: Keep the voice. Find the meaning.

notes.layout: Peach proposition, annotated transcript visual, research library, long-form study pages and a source-linked insight notebook
notes.motion: Passage highlighting, theme changes, contextual evidence selection and export-panel focus
notes.interaction: Filter interviews, highlight passages, assign themes, write and edit source-cited insights, preserve evidence and export Markdown
notes.provenance: Seven original pages with three fictional interviews, nine source passages and manual, evidence-based local research workflows.
